I will put two bags of fertilizer on my plot this year — one bag of the government NPK and one bag of urea that I got through the subsidy — because my sister did this last season and her maize was very good. I also have two cartloads of manure from my goats that I will spread before planting, and I will use my own seed that I saved from last year because the new seeds cost too much. I do not buy chemicals — I pull weeds with my hands — and I wait for the rains because I have no pump. My children and I will work about fifty days on this plot, but I will not hire anyone because I have no money for wages.
